{{Quote|Serving in the TDF, I've been ordered to do things that I wonder if I could explain while looking old Findal in the eye. But you have to understand what these sectors were like before the Trade Federation arrived. And if it were made to leave? '''Firmus Kett''' was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Trade Defense Force|Defense Force]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Great Peace of the Republic|final century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was the great-great-great-grandson of [[Findal Kett]], who in [[214 BBY]] had made the family company, [[Kett Shipping]], a subsidiary of the Trade Federation.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

The Kett family had been controlling the shipment of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] and [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] out of [[Cotellier/Legends|Cotellier]] and throughout the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before Firmus' [[Time/Legends|time]]. Kett transports moved up the [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] to [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]], where the ore and crystals were sold on for export to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] or the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The transports would then return to Cotellier with grain or agricultural supplies. The company made the Ketts relatively wealthy, and Firmus controlled the family's ancestral holdings, investments on [[Ma'ar Shaddam/Legends|Ma'ar Shaddam]] and [[Rseik]] proper, and a holiday [[Kett family retreat|retreat]] on [[Z'trop]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

Firmus attributed the family's success to the Trade Federation, in particular Findal Kett's decision to make Kett Shipping a subsidiary. Firmus disliked the policies of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] who had since come to dominate the Trade Federation, in particular their control of the ore and crystal trade, and their role in the shipment of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. He accepted that the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin]] and [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sectors]] were effectively Trade Federation vassals, and admitted to having followed orders in the TDF that he was not proud of. However, he was well aware of the intense [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]] that had plagued the region before the Trade Federation arrived, and had no confidence in the Galactic Republic to maintain order should the Trade Federation leave.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Findal Kett was supposed to be first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2012]] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. The piece was intended to illustrate the initial positive influence of the Trade Federation that had allowed it to amass so much power by the time of the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. However, it was ultimately cut from the final product for being both uninteresting and excessively focused on the minutiae of the [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]]. The section was later published as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] starting in [[2013]].
